$doc: How the marker id is shown: the marker kind's one shape, a label put up
at a place (cell/id.json). A marker's zoom is the web map's whose 16-pixel
cell, a mark's, is its scale on the camera grid's cells, as a place's is
(pxl-spec block/object.rs `MARKER_LATTICE`); its own, apart from the
places', since a marker is drawn as its own design. Per id where the class
comes to hold more than one shape.
The zoom a marker shows from: the one every place was shown from before
places followed Carto (OpenMapTiles' `poi` layer holds every point from
z14), kept for what someone puts up, which Carto has no rule for.
A marker's cell on the camera grid, in zooms: −1 spans two of the grid's
cells, as a place's icon does.
